text_markup: Either player can win by collecting agenda points in their score area (usually done by scoring or stealing agendas; see {ref:sec_score_scoring_steal}). A player with a score of 7 or more wins the game.
text_plain: Either player can win by collecting agenda points in their score area (usually done by scoring or stealing agendas; see section 1.17). A player with a score of 7 or more wins the game.
